name: Red one: custom 5-inch squashed X, 6S
notes: The owner's own quad (2026-11-08): frame, motors, props and weight from the owner; motor lag, thrust, inertia, yaw and pack sag measured from its Betaflight blackbox log (docs/notes/physics.md §2v, docs/evidence/2026-11-08-red-one-blackbox). Rates and PIDs are the owner's own tune from the same log.

wheelbase_mm.note: motor to motor corner to corner (the diagonal)

motor_spacing_front_rear_mm.note: squashed X: 138 mm front to rear, so 177.7 mm side to side from the 225 mm diagonal

battery.note: the owner is not sure which pack flew the log

battery_cells.note: 25.1 V at rest on a fresh pack

battery_capacity_mah.note: the smaller of the owner's two packs (1300 or 1450 mAh); only matters with Battery simulation on

twr.note: extrapolated to a fresh pack at full throttle from the log: 1458 rpm per volt at full command, 26.7 mOhm sag, thrust per rpm^2 1.45e-8 N at the top; punches measured 6.2-6.8 g on a part-used pack at 95 % command

inertia_roll_pitch_kgm2.note: roll 30 rad/s^2 per N of thrust difference x 88.9 mm half-spacing = 3.0e-3; pitch 23 x 69 mm = 3.0e-3; fitted with the pilot's sticks as instrument, about +-20 %

inertia_yaw_kgm2.note: yaw response gives rotor inertia / I_yaw = 1.56e-3 and kappa / I_yaw = 2.96; with the rotor inertia from its parts (below), I_yaw = 3.8e-3

motor_tau_ms.note: first-order lag from command to eRPM on all four motors: 16-20 ms (up 14-22, down 18-20), plus 2-3 ms delay partly in the telemetry

motor_kappa_m.note: 2.96 x I_yaw; the hover power agrees: 4 x 0.0112 x 1.72 N x 1194 rad/s = 92 W of prop power from 123 W drawn (75 %)

rpm_loaded_fraction.note: 1458 rpm per volt at full command / 1750 KV; at low command the real motor turns faster per volt (1950 at 10-20 %), which the model does not have

cda_horizontal_cm2.note: the Nazgul's estimate (same class); the log has no airspeed

cda_vertical_cm2.note: classic physics only; the Nazgul's estimate

cda_vertical_inflow_cm2.note: frame, pack and camera seen from above; the Nazgul's estimate

collider_duct_radius_mm.note: open props: one sphere per prop zone

collider_duct_offset_mm.note: spheres reach the prop tips: 112.5 mm to each motor + 64.8 mm prop radius - 45 mm sphere = 132 mm on the diagonal

pack_resistance_per_cell_ohm.note: 26.7 mOhm for the pack, wiring and XT60 (voltage against current, 88 s freestyle)

efficiency.note: prop power / electrical power in the hover (see motor_kappa_m)

camera_uptilt_deg.note: the game's Settings > Camera sets the angle; this is only the preset's default

rates.note: the owner's rates from the log header (rc_rates, rates, rc_expo)

pid_roll.note: the owner's tune from the log header: P, I, D, F (d_min 29 not modelled)

rotor_drag_per_s.note: momentum theory sqrt(g rho A_rotors / m) = 0.95 1/s x 0.55, as for the Nazgul

rotor_inertia_kgm2.note: 4.4 g prop (0.2 m R^2 = 3.7e-6) + 2207.5 bell (about 15 g at 12 mm = 2.2e-6); sets I_yaw and kappa through the measured ratios
